info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Status API enables users to access the current status of deliveries within the food delivery service. This endpoint allows consumers—such as delivery partners, restaurants, and customers—to efficiently monitor the real-time status of ongoing deliveries. By retrieving comprehensive delivery information, stakeholders can make informed decisions regarding order management and customer communication. Typical use cases include tracking delivery progress and estimating arrival times.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of deliveries.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the latest status of deliveries. It is useful for monitoring the progress of deliveries and understanding their current state.

requestBody.description: Request payload to retrieve the current status of deliveries. The client must provide relevant details as specified in the schema to successfully fetch the delivery status.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on deliveries status. It is a string value that should conform to the expected format.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesStatusResponse.title: Delivery Status Response

resultId.description: An identifier representing the result of the delivery status operation.

state.description: The current state of the delivery.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional context about the delivery status.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesStatusResponse.description: Schema representing the response for delivery status retrieval operations.
